description: This file is a shell script that sets up and tests the behavior of git's diff-tree functionality, particularly focusing on handling duplicate entries in trees, renames, and edge cases that could cause segfaults. It defines functions for creating git trees and uses various git commands to perform tests and assertions.

methods.name: make_tree_entry
methods.description: Creates a tree entry with specified mode, type, and SHA, and outputs it in a format suitable for git tree creation.

methods.name: make_tree
methods.description: Constructs a git tree object from multiple entries by repeatedly calling make_tree_entry and then hashing the assembled tree.
